svg.aria-label: Research map. 01 Multimodal (2024-25): APL, gamma-MoD, DViN. 02 Eval (2025-26): Open CaptchaWorld, Next-Gen CAPTCHAs, FigMirror. 03 Post-training (2026 onward): LongCat-2.5 (1.6T) and AutoDesign, where the model and its harness improve together.
